Orange, Peppers and Cabbage Salad
By: gypsy696
Published: Wednesday, December 15, 2010 - 5:57am

Ingredients




1 cup of cabbage
1 cup of green pepper
1/2 cup carrots
1/2 cucumber
1 tablespoon of sunflower seeds
12 blacks olives
1 1/2 oranges
2 jalepeno peppers
1 teaspoon of olive oil

Preparation

1 Chop up the cabbage, carrots, cucumber, and peppers into thin long slivers. 2 Juice half an orange. Mix this with the olive oil to make the dressing. 3 Peel and seperate the remaing orange. 4 Toss together the veggies with the jalepenos, olives and orange slivers. 5 Add the dressing. 6 Garnish with sunflower seeds.
